tagline: A calm place to get work done

posts.title: Community Events in August
content: Three events on the calendar this month: a lunchtime talk on freelance contracts, the monthly demo night, and Friday coffee on the terrace, weather permitting.
Demo night has outgrown the small meeting room, so we are moving it to the lounge. Five slots, five minutes each, sign-up sheet at the front desk.

pages.title: Welcome to Core
content: Core is a coworking space for people who like quiet mornings and fast wifi. Sixty desks, four meeting rooms, one very good coffee machine.
Day passes, dedicated desks, and private offices for teams of two to eight. Come for a trial day — the first one is on us.

pages.title: Open Desks
content: Grab any free desk in the open area. Day pass or monthly membership, both include meeting-room credits and the aforementioned coffee.
Monthly members get a locker, 24/7 access, and priority booking for the phone booths.

pages.title: Private Offices
content: Lockable offices for teams of two to eight, furnished, with your own air conditioning because that argument ruins teams.
Three offices available this quarter. Tours every weekday at noon.

pages.title: Meeting Rooms
content: Four rooms, from a two-person call box to a twelve-seat boardroom. Bookable by the hour through the member portal.
All rooms have a screen, a decent camera, and a whiteboard with pens that actually work. We check weekly.

pages.title: Contact
content: Rua do Nucleo 42, ground floor. Doors open 8:00 to 20:00 for visitors, always open for members.
Write to hello@corecoworking.com or just come by — the front desk is staffed all day.
